Derivation: Copy AE.USUBJID.

Label: Subject Identifier for the Study
Derivation: Copy ADSL.SUBJID for the same ADSL.USUBJID.

Label: Study Site Identifier
Derivation: Copy ADSL.SITEID for the same ADSL.USUBJID.

Label: Sequence Number
Derivation: Copy AE.AESEQ.

Label: Reported Term for the Adverse Event
Derivation: Copy AE.AETERM.

Label: Dictionary-Derived Term
Derivation: Copy AE.AEDECOD.

Label: Body System or Organ Class
Derivation: Copy AE.AEBODSYS.

Label: Lowest Level Term
Derivation: Copy AE.AELLT.

Label: Severity/Intensity
Derivation: Copy AE.AESEV.

Label: Analysis Severity/Intensity
Derivation: Copy AE.AESEV. The collected values are MILD, MODERATE, and SEVERE.

Label: Analysis Severity/Intensity (N)
Derivation: Set ASEVN from ADAE.ASEV. MILD has code 1, MODERATE has code 2, and SEVERE has code 3. Leave ASEVN missing for any other value.

Label: Causality
Derivation: Copy AE.AEREL. Leave AEREL missing when AE.AEREL is blank.

Label: Analysis Causality
Derivation: Copy AE.AEREL. Leave AREL missing when AE.AEREL is blank. Non-missing values stay NONE, REMOTE, POSSIBLE, or PROBABLE.

Label: Analysis Causality (N)
Derivation: Set ARELN from ADAE.AREL. NONE has code 1, REMOTE has code 2, POSSIBLE has code 3, and PROBABLE has code 4. Leave ARELN missing when ADAE.AREL is missing or has any other value.

Label: Serious Event
Derivation: Copy AE.AESER.

Label: Outcome of Adverse Event
Derivation: Copy AE.AEOUT.

Label: Results in Death
Derivation: Copy AE.AESDTH.

Label: Actual Treatment for Period 01
Derivation: Copy ADSL.TRT01A for the same ADSL.USUBJID.

Label: Actual Treatment for Period 01 (N)
Derivation: Copy ADSL.TRT01AN for the same ADSL.USUBJID.

Label: Safety Population Flag
Derivation: Copy ADSL.SAFFL for the same ADSL.USUBJID.

Label: Age
Derivation: Copy ADSL.AGE for the same ADSL.USUBJID.

Label: Sex
Derivation: Copy ADSL.SEX for the same ADSL.USUBJID.

Label: Race
Derivation: Copy ADSL.RACE for the same ADSL.USUBJID.

Label: Date of First Exposure to Treatment
Derivation: Copy ADSL.TRTSDT for the same ADSL.USUBJID.

Label: Date of Last Exposure to Treatment
Derivation: Copy ADSL.TRTEDT for the same ADSL.USUBJID.

Label: Analysis Start Date
Derivation: Impute ADAE.ASTDT from AE.AESTDTC. When AE.AESTDTC is a complete calendar day, use that day and do not impute. When AE.AESTDTC is a four digit year, a hyphen, and a two digit month, start at day 01 of that month. If ADSL.TRTSDT falls in that same month and day 01 is before ADSL.TRTSDT, move the imputed day forward to ADSL.TRTSDT. When AE.AESTDTC is a four digit year only, start at 01 January of that year. If ADSL.TRTSDT falls in that same year and 01 January is before ADSL.TRTSDT, move the imputed day forward to ADSL.TRTSDT. Leave ASTDT missing when AE.AESTDTC is blank or does not match one of those patterns. Do not impute a missing year.

Label: Analysis Start Date Imput. Flag
Derivation: Set ASTDTF from the same imputation as ADAE.ASTDT. Use D when the day was missing and a day was imputed. Use M when the month was missing and a month was imputed. Leave ASTDTF blank when AE.AESTDTC was a complete calendar day or when ADAE.ASTDT is missing. Moving an imputed day forward to ADSL.TRTSDT does not change D or M.

Label: Analysis End Date
Derivation: Impute ADAE.AENDT from AE.AEENDTC. When AE.AEENDTC is a complete calendar day, use that day. When AE.AEENDTC is a year and month, use the last calendar day of that month. If ADSL.TRTEDT falls in that same month and the last day is after ADSL.TRTEDT, move the imputed day back to ADSL.TRTEDT. When AE.AEENDTC is a year only, use 31 December of that year. If ADSL.TRTEDT falls in that same year and 31 December is after ADSL.TRTEDT, move the imputed day back to ADSL.TRTEDT. Leave AENDT missing when AE.AEENDTC is blank or does not match one of those patterns.

Label: Analysis End Date Imputation Flag
Derivation: Set AENDTF from the same imputation as ADAE.AENDT. Use D when the day was missing and a day was imputed. Use M when the month was missing and a month was imputed. Leave AENDTF blank when AE.AEENDTC was a complete calendar day or when ADAE.AENDT is missing.

Label: Analysis Start Relative Day
Derivation: Leave ASTDY missing when ADAE.ASTDT or ADSL.TRTSDT is missing. When ADAE.ASTDT is on or after ADSL.TRTSDT, subtract ADSL.TRTSDT from ADAE.ASTDT and add 1. When ADAE.ASTDT is before ADSL.TRTSDT, subtract ADSL.TRTSDT from ADAE.ASTDT and do not add 1.

Label: Analysis End Relative Day
Derivation: Leave AENDY missing when ADAE.AENDT or ADSL.TRTSDT is missing. When ADAE.AENDT is on or after ADSL.TRTSDT, subtract ADSL.TRTSDT from ADAE.AENDT and add 1. When ADAE.AENDT is before ADSL.TRTSDT, subtract ADSL.TRTSDT from ADAE.AENDT and do not add 1.

Label: AE Duration (N)
Derivation: When ADAE.ASTDT and ADAE.AENDT are both non-missing and ADAE.AENDT is on or after ADAE.ASTDT, set ADURN to ADAE.AENDT minus ADAE.ASTDT plus 1. Otherwise leave ADURN missing.

Label: AE Duration Units
Derivation: Set ADURU to DAYS when ADAE.ADURN is not missing. Otherwise leave ADURU blank.

Label: Treatment Emergent Analysis Flag
Derivation: Set TRTEMFL to Y when ADAE.ASTDT is not missing, ADSL.TRTSDT is not missing, ADAE.ASTDT is on or after ADSL.TRTSDT, and either ADSL.TRTEDT is missing or ADAE.ASTDT is on or before ADSL.TRTEDT plus 30 calendar days. Otherwise set TRTEMFL to N.

Label: Pre-treatment Flag
Derivation: Set PREFL to Y when ADAE.ASTDT and ADSL.TRTSDT are both non-missing and ADAE.ASTDT is before ADSL.TRTSDT. Otherwise set PREFL to N.

Label: 1st Occurrence of Any AE Flag
Derivation: Consider rows with ADAE.TRTEMFL equal to Y and ADAE.ASTDT not missing. Within each ADAE.USUBJID, sort by ADAE.ASTDT ascending and then by ADAE.AESEQ ascending. Set AOCCIFL to Y on the first row. Leave AOCCIFL blank on every other row, including rows that are not treatment emergent.

Label: 1st Occurrence of Preferred Term Flag
Derivation: Consider rows with ADAE.TRTEMFL equal to Y and ADAE.ASTDT not missing. Within each pair of ADAE.USUBJID and ADAE.AEDECOD, sort by ADAE.ASTDT ascending and then by ADAE.AESEQ ascending. Set AOCCPFL to Y on the first row. Leave AOCCPFL blank on every other row.

Label: 1st Occurrence of SOC Flag
Derivation: Consider rows with ADAE.TRTEMFL equal to Y and ADAE.ASTDT not missing. Within each pair of ADAE.USUBJID and ADAE.AEBODSYS, sort by ADAE.ASTDT ascending and then by ADAE.AESEQ ascending. Set AOCCSFL to Y on the first row. Leave AOCCSFL blank on every other row.

Label: Source Data
Derivation: Set SRCDOM to AE. Each row comes from AE and is traced by AE.AESEQ.

Label: Source Sequence Number
Derivation: Copy AE.AESEQ.
